purpose: Make one SceneGuard AgentTeams run replayable, bounded and independently verifiable.

accepted_evidence: HiClaw task and Matrix event metadata

consistency_invariants: one job_id is used by every role
profile id and version are unchanged across every artifact
PatchPlan asset hash equals the audited input hash
execution output hash equals regression candidate hash
GateDecision gate_state equals the team result gate_state
published asset hash equals the release attestation hash
every claimed artifact reference exists and passes the no-secret scan
autonomy_claim_rule: A run is autonomous only when no operator call, payload correction, worker substitution or manual artifact edit occurs between dispatch and terminal state.
